`mvn clean test -B` now passes with `jackson-databind` still at 2.12.6.1. The run shows 108 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors and 1 skipped.

The cause was a version mismatch. `pom.xml` pinned `jackson-annotations` to 2.9.9, but databind 2.12 needs the `JsonKey` annotation, which only exists from 2.12 on. That produced `NoClassDefFoundError: com/fasterxml/jackson/annotation/JsonKey` in the tests.

I changed `jackson-annotations` from 2.9.9 to 2.12.6 on line 59 of `pom.xml`. I touched no tests, build rules or Java level.

The skipped test is `ConstructQueryTest`. I didn't check where its skip comes from, but I didn't add it.
